persona.name: Marco Dandolo

goals.text: own a warehouse on the Rialto
keep the family fed and alive

secrets: father died owing the Ziani forty ducats
the rope sold to the Arsenale in 1339 was short-measured
persona.backstory: Son of a rope-maker who died in the fever of 1340, leaving a hank of unpaid debt and a bench in the Arsenale. Marco walks to work along the fondamenta before dawn, keeps his mother Agnese fed, and counts the ducats it would take to put his own name over a warehouse door at the Rialto.
